headline: 3 injured as cocktail explosion hits NCP rally in Savar
summary: Protesters later surrounded the local police station in protest of the attack on the National Citizens' Platform rally.
details: A cocktail explosion occurred during a rally organized by the National Citizens' Platform (NCP) in Savar, leaving three people injured.
The blast caused panic among the attendees of the political gathering.
Following the incident, angry protesters gathered and surrounded the local police station to express their outrage and demand action.
Local authorities are investigating the cause of the explosion and the identity of those responsible for the attack.
caption:
A cocktail explosion at a political rally in Savar left 3 people injured and sparked immediate protests.

A cocktail explosion occurred during a rally organized by the National Citizens' Platform (NCP) in Savar, leaving three people injured.

The blast caused panic among the attendees of the political gathering.

Following the incident, angry protesters gathered and surrounded the local police station to express their outrage and demand action.

Local authorities are investigating the cause of the explosion and the identity of those responsible for the attack.

headline_marked: 6 fishermen [[missing after trawler sinks]] in Bay of Bengal
headline: 6 fishermen missing after trawler sinks in Bay of Bengal
summary: Five people were rescued after their vessel capsized amid rough weather and strong currents 60km south of the Maudubi coast.
details: Six fishermen are missing after a fishing trawler sank in the Bay of Bengal on Sunday night. The incident occurred approximately 60km south of the Maudubi coast in Rangabali upazila of Patuakhali.
The trawler capsized at around 10:00 PM amid rough weather and strong currents. It had left for the sea on Saturday night with 11 fishermen on board.

Five fishermen, including Bayezid (30), managed to survive by clinging to broken parts of the vessel and a buoy. They drifted at sea for nearly six hours before being rescued at 3:00 AM by another fishing trawler.
The missing fishermen have been identified as Imadul Khan (45), Harun (60), Forkan (45), Sayed (20), Al-Amin (40), and Akkas (25).
Local administrations from Rangabali and Kalapara upazilas, along with the coast guard, have been notified and rescue operations are underway.
caption:
6 fishermen are missing after their trawler was struck by huge waves and sank in the Bay of Bengal.

Six fishermen are missing after a fishing trawler sank in the Bay of Bengal on Sunday night. The incident occurred approximately 60km south of the Maudubi coast in Rangabali upazila of Patuakhali.

The trawler capsized at around 10:00 PM amid rough weather and strong currents. It had left for the sea on Saturday night with 11 fishermen on board.

Five fishermen, including Bayezid (30), managed to survive by clinging to broken parts of the vessel and a buoy. They drifted at sea for nearly six hours before being rescued at 3:00 AM by another fishing trawler.

The missing fishermen have been identified as Imadul Khan (45), Harun (60), Forkan (45), Sayed (20), Al-Amin (40), and Akkas (25).

Local administrations from Rangabali and Kalapara upazilas, along with the coast guard, have been notified and rescue operations are underway.
